claim: A human chronic-MS imaging and histopathology study reported CXCR4 and phospho-CXCR4 on reactive microglia/macrophages in active or chronic-active lesions, including MHC-II/CXCR4 double-positive cells.
future_grounding_route: Use only as independent lesion-context corroboration. The study does not isolate the project's normal-appearing-tissue donor-level CD44/CXCR4 score and therefore cannot satisfy the frozen replication specification.
project_use: Independent human-tissue context for CXCR4 in inflammatory MS lesion myeloid cells.
relationship_note: The source supports CXCR4 as part of an inflammatory lesion-associated myeloid state. Its microglia/macrophage resolution, lesion context, and assay differ from the project analysis, so it is not same-definition replication or target-direction evidence.

source.citation: Moll et al. Imaging correlates of leukocyte accumulation and CXCR4/CXCL12 in multiple sclerosis. Archives of Neurology. 2009.
source.label: Moll 2009 CXCR4/CXCL12 histopathology in chronic MS

source_terms.license_or_terms_label: PubMed/PMC bibliographic metadata and short paraphrase
source_terms.reuse_notes: This record stores bibliographic metadata and a short paraphrase only; no source images or article text are redistributed.

why_unverifiable: The project has not rerun the source study's histopathology or obtained its patient-level measurements.
